question: In 1526, ______ was defeated by Babur at Panipat.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ibrahim Lodi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __The First Battle of Panipat__:

__
 
• The first battle of Panipat was fought in 1526 between Babur and Ibrahim Lodi.
 
• ​In 1526, the Mughal forces of Babur, the Timurid ruler of Kabulistan, defeated the much larger ruling army of Ibrahim Lodi, Sultan of Delhi.​
 
• Panipat was a legendary location where after 1526, multiple battles were fought between the Mughals and varying other forces.
 
• He was invited by Daulat Khan, the governor of Punjab, to invade the region and unsettle Ibrahim Lodi.
 
• Lodi’s army relied heavily on cavalry and especially on elephants, which in earlier times, could shock the enemy and rout them.
 
• This battle made the foundation of the Mughal dynasty in India.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Sikander Lodi

 
• Sikander Lodhi ruled from the year 1489-1517. 
 
• He swore the title Sikandar Shah and ascended the throne
 
• Sikandar Lodi became the next ruler of the Lodi dynasty after the death of his father Bahlul Lodi in July 1489.
 
• Work on music named “Lahjati-Sikandar Shahi” was created during his reign.

**Bahlul Lodi **

 
• Bahlul Lodi was the founder of the Lodi Dynasty.
 
• He ruled from the year 1451 -1489 A.D.
 
• Mewat, Sakit, Gwalior, etc were conquered by him.
